headline: DexCom (DXCM) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift After Analyst Target Increases
summary: DexCom’s fair value estimate has shifted from US$85.24 to US$91.64, marking a moderate uplift in the price target range currently referenced for the stock. This move lines up with recent analyst commentary, where many firms are reaffirming or raising targets, while a smaller group trims expectations on valuation concerns and growth assumptions.
